column1: # Pulled 2026-08-20 via the Looker MCP. There is no Looker credential in this
# repo, so a scheduled tool CANNOT refresh this -- it is exported by hand, the
# same shape as tools/log_campaign_performance.py parsing Max's Slack replies.
# Refresh procedure and the query filters are in docs/campaign-benchmarks.md.
#          start_date after 2024/01/01, sorted by total_signatures desc, top 60.
# NOT the full EN_GB population: the table also holds warm-up and test programs
# under a DIFFERENT naming format (underscore dates, "TEST_WARM_UP", "Warmup",
# "L1") which all carry zero signatures. This is the 60 largest real campaigns.
# money is EUR. otd = one-time donations, md = monthly donations.
